why: three facts were measured by the lanes after the r8 chapter was written and published; they narrow, but do not reverse, the chapter's WP19 and WP21 rows, so they are recorded here rather than by rewriting the chapter (which would change the document digest)

items.fact: HG-KSEOS imports the third-party module cryptography in three source modules while pyproject declares dependencies = []

measured.import_style: lazy, inside the function, wrapped so a missing module fails closed (refusal, never a pass)
measured.command: grep -rl cryptography src | sort; grep -n dependencies -A4 pyproject.toml

items.impact: a fresh install without cryptography refuses signature verification instead of failing open; the packaging defect is that the requirement is undeclared, so the refusal is silent until a signature path is exercised
items.irony: shw097-team/SBL carries a supply-chain gate whose self-test refuses exactly this class (UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY); HG-KSEOS has no CI, so nothing runs that gate there
items.disposition: owner item HGK-CI-ABSENT gains a second reason; not corrected here (another repository's packaging is not this round's write)

items.fact: SEAM-09 carries a slash in its title, so a naive identifier regex counts 10 seams instead of 11
items.impact: a reader re-deriving the SEAM denominator with a permissive pattern will undercount by one and conclude the plan is short; the repair fragments carry the correct 11

items.fact: the SBL supply-chain claim has two parts with different evidence: the gate is reproducible offline, the CI conclusion is a hosted readback

measured.offline: python tools/supply_chain_check.py --self-test -> baseline PASS (0 findings) and three mutations REFUSED (SBOM_COMPONENT_MISMATCH, UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY, LICENSE_MISSING_FOR_REQUIRED), exit 0
measured.hosted: the job conclusion success is read from the check-runs API; it cannot be re-derived offline

items.impact: 'green' should always be read as the hosted conclusion, while the gate's discrimination is reproducible; the chapter's WP19 row keeps REPRODUCED at that scope
